missing_bars.note: Amendment 1's universe is Alpaca assets on NYSE/NASDAQ/AMEX; a name with no Alpaca asset is outside the rule, not missing data. No fetch was needed: every re-admitted ticker that is an Alpaca asset has bars.

data_completeness.form25_note: All filers: Form 25-NSE (exchange) and 25 (issuer) cover every delisted class of security on a national exchange (common stock, preferreds, warrants, units, notes, ETFs). The index has no security-class field, so this is an upper bound on common-stock delistings, not a match.

delisted_59.unmapped_note: unmapped = no CIK in ciks.json and no S&P 500 panel price; the bars endpoint rejects the symbol, so no typed date is available here
